brief: Free & open-source local webcam and microphone turning Android smartphones into native Fedora Linux v4l2loopback and PipeWire studio devices without paywalls or cloud relays.
criteria: Distinct from generic 6-blade aperture clichés, legible at 16 px in Linux trays and browser tabs, consistent across Android Adaptive Icons, Rust egui desktop UI, and GitHub.

concepts.name: Miter Frame
concepts.idea: Two 45-degree mitered cinema viewfinder brackets lock around a live emerald optical lens core.
rationale: 45° machined miter joinery expresses 'Craft' and the low-latency bridge between Android and Fedora Linux.
Three-tier ArtCraft Studio v2 palette (#0D0F14 / #F8FAFC, #3B82F6 Electric Blue, #10B981 Signal Emerald) retains instant recognition from 16 px tray icons up to 1280 px banners.
Optically tuned small-size cut and irradiation-thinned reversed white master ensure crisp reproduction on OLED, print, and Light/Dark themes.

recommendation: Miter Frame — ready for full rollout across Android Adaptive Icons, Fedora camcraft-gui, Web/PWA, and GitHub README.
